data.title: Anthropic set to make stock market debut as questions swirl about safety of AI | CNN Business
data.description: Anthropic filed for an initial public offering Monday in what could become one of the largest stock market debuts in history — detailing its surging business growth, along with a vast multitude of warnings about how it could all go wrong.
data.author: Lisa Eadicicco, Clare Duffy, John Towfighi
